warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70, 0.60/0.50) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m); ป1 and น3 print 0.70 + 0.70 / 0.60 + 0.60 leaves under the overall width. Door heights 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง.
Two windows print an overall height that does not equal sill + window: น3 0.85 + 1.10 = 1.95 against 2.05, น4 1.65 + 0.40 = 2.05 against 2.15 — kept the printed values, flagged.
